changes.why: v0.10.0 renamed foldl to reduce with the same code (_curry3(_foldl) became _curry3(_reduce); commit 'use consistent names'); R.foldl is gone
v0.10.0 renamed foldr to reduceRight with the same code; R.foldr is gone
v0.10.0 renamed foldlIndexed to reduceIndexed with the same code
v0.10.0 renamed foldrIndexed to reduceRightIndexed with the same code
v0.10.0 renamed mapAccumL to mapAccum with the same code
v0.10.0 renamed mapAccumR to mapAccumRight with the same code
v0.10.0 renamed scanl to scan with the same code
v0.10.0 renamed unfoldr to unfold with the same code
v0.10.0 renamed mixin to merge with the same body (commit 'rename R.mixin'); R.mixin is gone
knock-on of the foldl removal: the revealed body called foldl and now calls reduce (Ramda's _ap folds with _reduce, the renamed _foldl), same results
knock-on of the foldl removal: the revealed body called foldl and now calls reduce, same results
v0.10.0's commuteMap folds with _reduce (the renamed _foldl) and foldl is gone: the revealed body calls reduce instead of foldl, same results
knock-on of commuteMap: its revealed body calls commuteMap, whose body changed; same results
v0.10.0's new name for foldl, same code (v0.9.0 had removed reduce, which was foldl's primary from v0.4.0 to v0.8.0): acc = fn(acc, list[idx]) for idx ascending
v0.10.0's new name for foldr, same code (v0.9.0 had removed reduceRight): acc = fn(acc, list[idx]) for idx descending
v0.10.0's new name for foldlIndexed, same code: acc = fn(acc, list[idx], idx, list) for idx ascending
v0.10.0's new name for foldrIndexed, same code: acc = fn(acc, list[idx], idx, list) for idx descending
v0.10.0's new name for mapAccumL, same code
v0.10.0's new name for mapAccumR, same code
v0.10.0's new name for scanl, same code
v0.10.0's new name for unfoldr, same code (with the port's fuel bound)
new in v0.10.0 (@category List): R.mergeAll = reduce(merge, {}), the objects merged left to right, later keys winning
v0.10.0's new name for mixin, same body (_extend(_extend({}, a), b), b's keys winning), now op-curried; not the list merge removed from Core in v0.2.4
new in v0.10.0: R.dissoc(prop, obj), a copy of obj without the property prop (_pickBy(key !== prop))
new in v0.10.0 (@category Logic): R.defaultTo(d, v) is v unless v is null or undefined (None here), then d
